Title: 3 Everyday Foods That May Trigger Your Migraines

Description:
Wine with dinner, takeout on the way home, and a diet soda to wash it down - and by morning your temples are throbbing again?

Red wine, MSG-heavy takeout, and diet soda are three of the everyday triggers doctors hear about most, each working on your blood vessels or nerves in a different way.

Watch to find out why, and small swaps that may help.
